artifact.note: Untrained masked migration of the provisional issue 91 A/r3 Task 2 parent. Carried as the unchanged reference through every Task 3 comparison and measured best in all of them; installed on that descriptive basis, not by passing a registered gate.

selection.rationale: Four registered comparisons (approach shaping, update cadence, compensated elimination reward, opponent-weight shrinkage) each failed their screens and none promoted a checkpoint. All four measured this artifact as the strongest available, and the shrinkage dose-response converged on it monotonically, which the protocol registered in advance as the signature of undirected drift in the trainable opponent columns.

measured_on_320_hunting_worlds.suite: classic with one peaceful_agent, four independent forty-world sets

supersedes.note: Compatibility migration of the historical corrected issue 85 Task 2 checkpoint; never endorsed by any experiment.

runtime_modes.note: Both modes are recorded in the checkpoint and differ from the superseded fixture, which had them disabled. Missing environment selectors preserve the checkpoint's modes; explicit mismatches fail.

training_state.note: Untrained. Its thirteen opponent-input columns remain at their zero initialization, which is the setting the Task 3 comparisons found to be the best available for them.

parent.task2_gate_status: mixed_negative; no Task 2 completion claim follows from installing this artifact

rule: copy all parent input columns, hidden layers and six outputs for online and target networks
preserve parent mask and escape mode; reset optimizer, replay, epsilon, RNG and update count

retrieval.note: The same bytes are a member of every Task 3 comparison's evidence archive.
